nodes.description: HER performance in 1.0 M KOH three-electrode configuration (LSV, Tafel, Cdl, stability)
nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution performance was evaluated in a standard three-electrode configuration. The RuNi-MoO₂ attains 10 and 100mAcm⁻² at the ultralow overpotentials of 19 and 86mV, respectively (Figure 2a). RuNi-MoO₂ discloses a much lower Tafel slope value of 35.7mVdec⁻¹ (Figure 2b). RuNi-MoO₂ possesses the largest electrochemical double-layer capacitance (Cdl) value of 13.02mFcm⁻² (Figure 2d). The chronoamperometry measurements at a potential of −0.09V versus RHE and −0.125V versus RHE display tiny current density decay rates of 6.56μAcm⁻²h⁻¹ for 150h and 14.20μAcm⁻²h⁻¹ for 300h, respectively (Figure 2f).

nodes.description: AEMWE overall water splitting performance with NiFe-LDH anode
nodes.source_text: The RuNi-MoO₂||NiFe-LDH AEMWE attains an industrial current density of 1Acm⁻² at a low voltage of 1.71V (Figure 5b)... The hydrogen production rate of RuNi-MoO₂||NiFe-LDH AEMWE increases from 5.76±0.08mmol cm⁻²h⁻¹ at the cell voltage of 1.65 V to 19.82±0.48mmol cm⁻²h⁻¹ at 1.72 V. Meanwhile, RuNi-MoO₂||NiFe-LDH AEMWE discloses Faradaic efficiencies over 90% at the whole cell voltage window (Figure 5c)... chronoamperometry measurement of the RuNi-MoO₂||NiFe-LDH AEMWE at a voltage of 1.72V exhibits an industrial current density over 1Acm⁻² over 1000h with a tiny current density decay rate of 17.27μAcm⁻²h⁻¹ (Figure 5d).

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Ni 2p3/2 XPS spectra of RuNi-MoO2 show deconvoluted peaks at 853.07 eV (Ni0) and 856.27 eV (Ni2+) with 0.2 eV positive shift for Ni0 vs Ni-MoO2; Ru 3p3/2 shows peaks at 461.97 eV (Ru0) and 464.67 eV (RuX+) with 0.4 eV negative shift vs Ru-MoO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1d displays Ni 2p3/2 spectra of RuNi-MoO2 and Ni-MoO2, the deconvoluted peaks at 853.07 and 856.27 eV are corresponding to the Ni^0 and Ni^{2+} respectively, in the spectra of RuNi-MoO2. Noteworthy, the peak position corresponding to metal Ni^0 shows an evident positive shift of 0.2 eV... Figure 1e presents the Ru 3p3/2 spectra of RuNi-MoO2 and Ru-MoO2, the deconvoluted peaks at 461.97 and 464.67 eV correspond to the Ru^0 and Ru^{X+}...
